bias: quantitative neuroscience/cognitive mechanisms then demonstrated AI transfer

non_regression.rule: Preserve config6 substantive neuroscience role, all prior scientific findings and exact base continuation, CLEAN semantic isolation, tested-scope/provenance, checkpoint/resume, failure recovery, anti-stop semantics, role-local write boundary and restoration metadata. Config7 changes only current Phase-1 authority binding and per-invocation lifecycle granularity needed to execute the already-authorized sanitized Phase-1 assignment under RUN_LIFECYCLE.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads. Prior scientific state is preserved as evidence/frontier and fallback metadata but does not override a current Phase-1 assignment in the frozen sanitized root.
policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: Open-ended across recurring invocations; checkpoints/findings/blockers are never global completion. Per RUN_LIFECYCLE execute exactly one highest-value checkpoint-first single-effect-chain Phase-1 neuroscience slice, persist and exact-read back role-local evidence/checkpoint plus a nonempty continuation, then return recurring-open when frontier remains. Never intentionally run until a hard runtime/tool boundary and never begin an optional second effect chain in the same invocation.
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts. Every Phase-1 receipt/checkpoint must explicitly bind phase_id/root_problem_id/assignment_task_id, the exact frozen DESIRED_STATE parsed control_revision plus Git blob SHA, this exact neuroscience config parsed config_revision plus Git blob SHA, bootstrap_valid, global_completion=false, enabled_desired=true, termination, and a nonempty exact continuation. Parse authority revisions only from those exact frozen control bodies. Any authority mismatch/unverifiable identity is diagnostic-only and cannot count as positive Phase-1 evidence.

control_freshness.preferred: Obtain note main SHA only via a SHA-only ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main. At H1 read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config at that exact SHA, parse and freeze both path/revision/blob identities, then repeat SHA-only ref lookup before substantive work and restart bootstrap only if a frozen authoritative identity changed.
control_freshness.chat_fallback: When SHA-only ref lookup is unavailable, read only sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config twice before the first own-state/public semantic read, require identical returned path/blob/revision tuples and matching cross-control phase/root/task references, then freeze transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.fallback_failure: Diagnostic checkpoint only; preserve enabled_desired=true, global_completion=false and an exact retry continuation. Missing preferred transport is unresolved and never authority to mutate the scheduler or consume stale substantive prompt defaults.
control_freshness.post_freeze: The first own-state/public-source semantic read freezes semantics. Unrelated generic main advancement alone is not a semantic stop; do not consume newer-head semantics. Exact authority identity may be revalidated using SHA/path/blob-only transport when required, and own role-local writes remain current-blob/CAS/readback guarded.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.purpose: Prevent a recurring neuroscience invocation from losing scheduler persistence or durable continuation while preserving the full CLEAN scientific role.

preflight_checkpoint.timing: Immediately after valid authority freeze and own-state reconstruction, before optional or expensive public semantic work.

single_effect_chain.definition: The smallest safe neuroscience/state-reconstruction unit whose evidence and continuation are complete after mandatory persistence/readback; never split an integrity-atomic sequence.
preferred_units: one concrete blocker diagnosis with alternative-route continuation
single_effect_chain.after_chain: Persist/read back role-local checkpoint/output and immutable own receipt where applicable, then return recurring-open with exact continuation. Do not start another optional effect chain in the same invocation.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.terminal_marker_semantics: ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: is lifecycle output only and is never semantic completion evidence.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist the exact blocker and next executable CLEAN-safe Phase-1 continuation; unavailable capability remains unresolved.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If config7 weakens CLEAN isolation, tested scope/provenance, scientific continuation, exact authority binding or role-valid useful output without improving recurring persistence, increment config and repair the lifecycle mechanism; never disable the role or restore run-until-hard-stop behavior.

phase1_assignment_contract.activation_rule: When the exact frozen DESIRED_STATE says the Phase-1 clean overlay is active and assigns this task to neuroscience, this is the active assignment for the invocation. The substantive base neuroscience role, prior scientific findings/frontier, recovery semantics and exact base continuation remain preserved as restoration metadata, not as default active work during Phase 1.
phase1_assignment_contract.first_valid_run_requirement: After a fresh valid bootstrap, reconstruct the latest own clean LATEST/STATE, preserve its scientific/base continuation verbatim by reference, and first persist/read back a task-bound checkpoint proving the current phase/root/task and exact root/config provenance. Then execute exactly one smallest own-state/public-source Phase-1 probe that can falsify safe state reconstruction and recurrence-sensitive checkpoint continuation for this role.
phase1_assignment_contract.expected_output: A current phase/root/task-bound role-local artifact and immutable own receipt with bootstrap_valid=true, exact frozen root/config provenance, base_continuation_preserved=true, a concrete tested state-reconstruction/continuation mechanism or exact missing Chat capability, exact tested scope, and a nonempty Phase-1 frontier.
phase1_assignment_contract.base_state_reuse_rule: Existing CAUSE/PF-HMM, latent-cause, memory-control or other neuroscience findings may be reused only as own scientific evidence when directly relevant to the current Phase-1 mechanism test. Their existence alone is not Phase-1 acceptance proof and must not substitute for the current task-bound checkpoint/receipt.
phase1_assignment_contract.completion_block_rule: If the current subleaf completes, is Chat-infeasible, becomes blocked or loses marginal value, checkpoint the concrete result/blocker and preserve the next highest-value non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf inside the clean neuroscience/state-reconstruction domain as the next recurring continuation. Do not restore unrelated base research as active work while Phase 1 remains active.

authority_order: exact frozen DESIRED_STATE Phase-1 overlay and CLEAN safety boundary
exact frozen current neuroscience role config
current_assignment_precedence_contract.rule: Current repository control chooses active work. Preserve prior role-local scientific content and exact base continuation without deletion or reinterpretation, but do not execute prior procedural continuation when it conflicts with the current Phase-1 overlay. Such a conflict is stale_active_assignment_metadata, not permission to discard history.

stale_phase1_binding_detection.observed_baseline: The durable neuroscience LATEST remains a 2026-08-28 scientific continuation carrying older authority metadata. Preserve its scientific contents but do not treat that metadata as current Phase-1 authority.
stale_phase1_binding_detection.classification_rule: If the latest own state lacks the current Phase-1 phase/root/task binding, or its authority metadata cannot be reconciled to the exact frozen current root/config, preserve its scientific contents but classify current Phase-1 binding as stale/unproven. Fresh-bootstrap and emit a new task-bound checkpoint/receipt before treating the role as a positive Phase-1 cell.

migration.reason: A durable 2026-08-30 neuroscience receipt proved config6 could not bootstrap the current sanitized Phase-1 assignment because its role-local root_problem_id was still v2 while DESIRED_STATE control26 uses v4. The first live post-repair scheduler boundary also found the same task stopped and required same-task re-enable, with no newer durable neuroscience receipt. Config7 removes the exact cross-control mismatch and adopts checkpoint-first single-effect-chain lifecycle slicing under RUN_LIFECYCLE while preserving all scientific/CLEAN semantics.
migration.rollback_condition: Only if config7 broadens CLEAN semantic inputs, erases or weakens prior scientific/base continuation, weakens exact scope/provenance/recovery, or prevents authorized role-local checkpointing. Repair by incrementing again; never restore the v2 cross-control mismatch, unrelated base work as active Phase-1 work, or deliberate hard-boundary execution.
